paragraphs: Mentioned in Pesikta Rabbati, Ki Tisa, at the printed locator 69; R' Tanchuma, his son, reported in his name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ׳ תשא-סט gives the Tisa section, conventionally Ki Tisa, and numeral 69 without specifying a page or section unit. פ׳ is not forced into parashah rather than piska. No modern edition mapping or independent named check is claimed.
The line-broken ר׳ תנחומא belongs to one name. Tanchuma is his son and reports in the heading figure’s name; that relationship remains Hyman’s assertion. Both title abbreviations remain R'.
